> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People in a marriage usually live together.

> Fact From Story: Jada Pinkett Smith revealed that she and husband Will Smith have been separated for the last seven years.
> > Fact From Story: Both Jada and Will have previously doubled down on their stance against getting a divorce.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If two people are separated, they are not together.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Seven years is a long time to be separated.
